title: Act: Add Exporter with frozen-only filtering
summary: Create exporter.go with Exporter and Export method
description: Create backend/internal/contribution/exporter.go defining Exporter wrapping an ExportSource and building an Export from frozen contributions.
acceptance_criteria: Exporter.Export returns only frozen contributions in snapshot order
Fields map PlayerID to Author and Prompt to Content

steps.action: Create package contribution file with type Exporter struct{ Source ExportSource } and func NewExporter(src ExportSource) *Exporter, each with a doc comment
steps.code:
type Exporter struct{ Source ExportSource }
func NewExporter(src ExportSource) *Exporter { return &Exporter{Source: src} }
steps.expected: Package compiles with the new type

steps.action: Add Export(ctx context.Context, worldID, roundID string) (Export, error): call Source.ListByRound and Source.FrozenIDs, index the contributions by ID in a map, then for each frozen id in order append ExportContribution{ID: c.ID, Author: c.PlayerID, Content: c.Prompt, CreatedAt: c.CreatedAt} when present in the map; return Export{Version: ExportVersion, WorldID: worldID, RoundID: roundID, Contributions: out}
